name: Prioritisation
intent: Put effort into the few things that matter most, not everything at once.
outcome: Resources and attention go where they will do the most to move the economy.

name: Discipline of Execution
intent: Convert priorities into actionable plans and routine performance management.
outcome: Delivery through weekly updates, monthly reviews and rapid escalation.

name: Accountability & Oversight
intent: Make results owned and reported, with clear responsibility at every level.
outcome: Performance is visible and acted on, not left to year-end.

name: Adaptive Management
intent: Use evidence to adjust and improve delivery as conditions change.
outcome: Problems are caught early and interventions are corrected in time.

name: Alignment
intent: Connect national plans, policies and reforms into one delivery structure.
outcome: Every institution works to a common results structure.
